_comment: Default declared design scale. Projects may copy this to design-tokens.json and extend it deliberately. run-gates.py automatically prefers the project's file when present.
_units: Spacing, radius, fontSize and lineHeightPx are pixels at a 16px root; lineHeight is unitless; fontWeight is numeric.
rules: Add a value to the scale before using it. Do not use a value that is not here.
Never write a spacing or font value as a bare rem decimal. 0.72rem renders as 11.52px.
Radius: three values maximum per surface. Pills (999px) only for a control that is genuinely round.
A baseline must pass its own gate. If a starter fails, every project built from it inherits the drift.
_project: StealthRDP: negative offsets are declared, and 999 is the pill radius for genuinely round controls. lineHeight and fontWeight are declared from values the project actually uses; 760 is a deliberate variable-font weight.
